summary: This document extends the identifiers used in the MPLS Transport Profile (MPLS-TP). Identifiers following IP/MPLS conventions already existed. This adds identifier formats typically used by the ITU-T for MPLS-TP management and Operations, Administration, and Maintenance (OAM) functions.

eli5.summary: Telephone-style networks and internet-style networks name things differently. This adds the telephone-style names so both groups can talk about the same equipment.
